turns.text: Hey Lloyd, quick question. I'm writing up the initial launch report for the RL-100 unit.
Hi Alan. I can help with that. What specific metrics do you need to include?
Just the deployment duration for the pilot phase. It was a short test.
Understood. What was the total time it was active?
It ran for 4 hours in the mall.
Got it. 4 hours is noted for the pilot phase. Did you run into any hardware issues during that time?
Actually, yes. The battery connector was loose. I had to order a replacement from the vendor.
That sounds frustrating. Did the replacement arrive quickly?
No, it's still stuck in customs. Anyway, just note down the 4 hours for the report.
Lloyd, update on the RL-100. We finished the extended field test today.
Welcome back, Alan. Did the new battery connector solve the issue from last time?
Yes, it held up fine. But the test duration was longer than we planned.
How much longer did it go? I need to update your records.
The RL-100 was deployed for 7 hours in a mall this time.
That is a significant increase from the initial 4-hour pilot. I will update the current status to reflect the 7-hour deployment.
Exactly. The data logs are huge now. I also noticed the air conditioning in the mall was struggling.
Noted. High traffic can impact environmentals too. Do you need me to format the log files?
No, I'll handle the logs. Just make sure you know the final duration is 7 hours.
